title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s Westwood-style RTS: a 20-mission four-act campaign with a branching Seal/Harness choice, 3 mechanically distinct factions, a prerequisite-gated tech tree with stacking research, buildable superweapons (Ion Cannon / Resonance Device), a living planet that hunts the greedy, saves/replays, and experimental 1v1/2v2 lockstep. v0.56 GAMEPLAY OVERHAUL: real RA-pace economy (tier 2 ~1 min, tier 3 ~2-3 min), 15-25 minute matches on a 48x48 map with contested expansions, three true AI difficulty personalities that build bases, expand, retreat and play behind fog-of-war, an RA-style win condition (no more hunting the last rifleman), and the full 24-unit / 23-structure roster reachable from a paged data-driven sidebar. v0.63 ARMY FEEL: a selected group marches at its slowest member's pace (WC3 group movement — the hero no longer reaches the enemy alone), units pick targets their weapon is good against instead of whatever is nearest, radar pings and an EVA "Unit lost" line for field losses, and scripted camera beats glide instead of cut. v0.64 MODERN DISPLAY: fills any widescreen window with sharp high-DPI rendering and more visible battlefield, loads a fraction of the data, adds soft fog, a selection panel with one-click army and control-group access, a settings screen with rebindable keys and fullscreen, and touch controls for tablets.
assetLicenseSummary: All assets project-generated, no third-party files: unit/building sprites via xAI Grok Imagine, presentation illustrations via OpenAI image generation, terrain code-drawn, audio procedural. See ASSETS.md.
